meta.name: create-command
meta.description: Create a new slash command for Claude Code. Guides the user through defining the command name, what it does, and generates the markdown file in .claude/commands/. Use when the user says 'create a command', 'new command', 'add a slash command', 'I want a shortcut for', or wants to create a reusable slash command.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 Claude Code 创建可复用的斜杠命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Claude Code 中重复执行相同操作，想用斜杠命令一键完成。
copy.tagline_en: Create reusable slash commands for Claude Code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat tasks in Claude Code and want a shortcut.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你定义命令名称、功能，并自动生成一个斜杠命令文件。以后在 Claude Code 里输入“/命令名”就能快速执行该命令。
howto.when: 当你说“创建命令”、“新命令”、“添加斜杠命令”或“我想要一个快捷方式”时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 /deploy 命令来检查部署状态。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成定义并生成命令文件。

say.text: 新建一个 /tickets 命令，用于查看工单。
say.note: Claude 会提示指定代理或直接生成指令。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to define the command name and what it does, then generates a slash command file. You can later invoke it in Claude Code by typing "/command-name".
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "create a command", "new command", "add a slash command", "I want a shortcut for", or express a desire to create a reusable slash command.

say_en.text: Create a /deploy command to check deployment status.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through defining it and generate the file.

say_en.text: Create a /tickets command to view tickets.
say_en.note: Claude will prompt for agent or generate instructions.
